name: Лавочник
original_text:
Вы можете построить любое количество торговых кварталов.

Получите 1 золотой за каждый ваш торговый квартал.

qa.name: pass: exact original title visually verified
qa.rank: pass: exact original rank and emblem color
qa.text: pass: every word, punctuation and digits visually compared to source; two paragraphs and divider retained
qa.composition: Original character, pose, clothing, props, background and complete card composition retained with reinterpreted fine details
qa.identity: Original age, sex, hair, expression and identity cues retained with generative facial reinterpretation
qa.color: Original palette retained with soft contrast; approximate 10% lower intensity is unmeasured
qa.layout: Full rectangular card, ribbons and typography retained; small spacing changes

limitations: Generative restoration reinterprets fine details and facial rendering.
Approximate 10% lower color intensity is a prompt target, not measured.
Raw generated PNG copied byte-for-byte; no resize, crop, padding or compression.

artisticApproval.statement: Принимаю. только убедись, чтобы пергамент на персонажах остался на прежнем месте и был выровнен
artisticApproval.condition: Preserve and align parchment positions against each original character JPG.
